name: Thomas A. Rodriguez
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Thomas A. Rodriguez, an attorney with Lathrop GPM in Denver, Colorado, helps clients address Estate Planning & Probate situations. He also helps clients with Elder Law concerns.
He received legal training from Emory University School of Law. He graduated from law school in 1998. Thomas Rodriguez became licensed to practice law in 1998.
Thomas Rodriguez was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2015 - 2027.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
